title: Frames, shapes and text
summary: Make a frame and draw shapes and text inside it.

steps.say: Open a Figma design file you can edit, for example a new blank design file.

checks.prompt: Is a Figma design file open, with the canvas and the bottom toolbar showing?

hints: From the file browser, use the new design file button at the top right.
View-only files hide editing tools; duplicate them to your drafts first.
steps.why: Editing needs a file where you have edit access.

steps.say: Press F for the Frame tool, then pick Desktop from the sizes in the right sidebar.

check.prompt: Is there a new frame on the canvas that is also listed in the layers list?

hints: You can also drag on the canvas to draw a frame of any size.
The Frame tool is the hash-shaped icon in the bottom toolbar.
steps.why: A frame is the screen or artboard everything else sits in.

steps.say: Press R, then drag inside the frame to draw a rectangle.

check.prompt: Is there a rectangle inside the frame, nested under it in the layers list?

hints: Start dragging inside the frame's border so the shape belongs to it.
The rectangle tool is in the shape menu of the bottom toolbar.
steps.why: Shapes drawn inside a frame move and resize with it.

steps.say: Press O and drag to draw a circle. Hold Shift while dragging for a perfect circle.

check.prompt: Is there an ellipse or circle inside the frame?

hints: O picks the Ellipse tool from the same shape menu as the rectangle.
Let go of the mouse before releasing Shift to keep it round.
steps.why: Most icons and buttons start from simple shapes.

steps.say: Press T, click inside the frame, and type Hello. Press Escape when finished.

check.prompt: Is there a text layer that reads Hello inside the frame?

hints: Single-letter shortcuts do not work while you are typing in a text box.
The Text tool is the T icon in the bottom toolbar.
steps.why: Text layers hold labels, headings and button captions.

steps.say: Double-click the frame's name in the layers list and type Home, then press Enter.

check.prompt: Is there a frame named Home in the layers list?

hints: The frame is the top row of the group, with your shapes indented below it.
Control R renames the selected layer too.
steps.why: Named frames are easier to link in prototypes and find later.
